biotools.summary: ADM1F is an open-source platform for fast and stable simulations of anaerobic digestion processes, leveraging PETSc for efficient numerical solutions. It features an iPython interface for model configuration, simulation, data analysis, and visualization, offering a significant speed advantage over conventional methods.
